text: Those who purchase the goods of a company. <break time="0.8s" /> Are called customers. <break time="0.8s" /> Individuals who purchase goods for personal use. <break time="0.8s" /> Are called consumers. <break time="0.8s" /> Beings who consume. <break time="0.8s" /> Therefore, companies have invented multiple ways. <break time="0.8s" /> To ensure that their customers consume the produced items. <break time="0.8s" /> In larger and larger quantities. <break time="0.8s" /> And more and more frequently. <break time="0.8s" /> Those who sell food have an easy time. <break time="0.8s" /> For food is literally consumed. <break time="0.8s" /> So there is always a need to purchase new food. <break time="0.8s" /> But with more permanent things. <break time="0.8s" /> Companies must invent reasons for their customers to continue to consume them. <break time="0.8s" /> One approach is to make the stuff that people already have outdated. <break time="0.8s" /> By convincing them that it is no longer fashionable. <break time="0.8s" /> The entire fashion industry is built. <break time="0.8s" /> To convince people that fashion matters. <break time="0.8s" /> So they must purchase new clothing. <break time="0.8s" /> Even though the old is still perfectly functionable. <break time="0.8s" /> Fashion today extends to far more things than clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> Automobiles, mobile phones, computers. <break time="0.8s" /> , the list is extended indefinitely. <break time="0.8s" /> Limited only by the limits. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the creative minds of the marketing divisions of companies.
